author: Xcode Project Dashboard · source review
scope: Focused review of 15 core rule groups and 15 concurrency/behaviour scenarios across playback, timing, presets and launch. Presentation-only gestures, visual styling and formatting are excluded from separation. Not an exhaustive whole-app certification; no tests or runtime tracing executed in this review.

findings.title: How does playback recover from an audio interruption?
findings.description: Preparation activates the audio session. No interruption or route-change observer was found. Define what the user should see when a call or audio-device change interrupts playback; this source review does not establish a reproduced failure.
findings.check: Exercise interruption, route change and media-services reset on device; assert the intended stop/resume and error behaviour.

findings.title: Should a failed preset decode erase the saved payload?
findings.description: The storage actor removes the preset key after any JSON decoding failure. That includes data the current schema cannot decode. Decide whether preserving or quarantining the payload would better support recovery.
findings.check: Test an unsupported schema and corrupt payload, including what remains available after a second load.

testQuality.scope: Focused review of 15 core rule groups and 15 concurrency/behaviour scenarios across playback, timing, presets and launch. Presentation-only gestures, visual styling and formatting are excluded from separation. Not an exhaustive whole-app certification; no tests or runtime tracing executed in this review.

scenarios.title: Input boundaries reject invalid tempo and indices
scenarios.detail: Assertions check clamping, non-finite input rejection and unchanged patterns.

scenarios.title: Repeated starts share pending work
scenarios.detail: Suspends start, launches another request, then asserts one start and one ticker.

scenarios.title: Stop during start prevents stale playback
scenarios.detail: Asserts cancellation, ordered start/stop/start and final playback state.

scenarios.title: Stop waits for an in-flight click
scenarios.detail: Asserts command ordering and no resumed visual beat after stop.

scenarios.title: Startup audio does not block preset loading
scenarios.detail: Both dependencies reach suspension before either is released.

scenarios.title: Initial-load edits keep submission order
scenarios.detail: Checks final BPM, persisted latest snapshot and a single named preset.

scenarios.title: Coalesced writes preserve edits despite caller cancellation
scenarios.detail: Checks two writes preserve three edits and clear saving state.

scenarios.title: Concurrent callers share one load
scenarios.detail: Asserts one repository load and loading state clears.

scenarios.title: Save captures input before suspension
scenarios.detail: Changes BPM during load and checks the captured original reaches storage.

scenarios.title: Failed saves can retry without duplication
scenarios.detail: Asserts visible failure, retained local edits and successful retry.

scenarios.title: Late audio refill skips expired beats
scenarios.detail: Checks skipped count, absolute deadlines and musical indices.

scenarios.title: Tempo changes preserve committed deadlines
scenarios.detail: Checks exact absolute deadlines after several pending updates.

scenarios.title: Audio interruption and route recovery
scenarios.detail: No interruption/route-change recovery test or notification handler found in the searched production/test scope. Agree intended resume/stop behaviour before writing tests.

scenarios.title: Live refill failure reaches visible feature state
scenarios.detail: Pure schedule tests cover deadlines, but a deterministic live refill-worker failure followed by feature error publication was not identified.

scenarios.title: Cancelling one caller leaves a shared preset load usable
scenarios.detail: Load sharing is tested, and save cancellation is tested. A focused cancelled-load-waiter scenario was not identified in MetronomeTests.

keep.title: Observation tests are not merely stored-property readbacks
keep.detail: The save-dialog test also checks observation invalidation and that draft editing leaves persisted feature state untouched. Those assertions protect a presentation contract; it should not be dismissed solely because a property is assigned.
